name: dicom-slides
summary: Interactive DICOM studies for browser presentations and PowerPoint slides.
intro: Explore image stacks, triplanar reconstructions and 3D volumes within a presentation. Import local DICOM files or prepare static study packages for educational and research material.

features.title: Three viewing modes
features.body: Navigate a 2D stack, synchronized MPR planes and WebGL2 volume rendering.

features.title: PowerPoint content add-in
features.body: Import files, folders or ZIP archives and embed the converted study in the presentation.

features.title: Reusable browser viewer
features.body: Embed the viewer as a web component or use the local demonstration.

features.title: Local conversion tools
features.body: Prepare static study packages with geometry and display settings.

support.title: Install in PowerPoint
paragraphs: Download the manifest from the repository and use Upload My Add-in in a supported PowerPoint client. Organization policy may block custom add-ins; the repository includes desktop installation instructions.

support.title: Import a study
paragraphs: Choose Files, Folder or ZIP in the add-in settings. Supported formats vary by importer; the browser importer includes JPEG 2000 and JPEG-LS decoders.

support.title: Run the browser version
paragraphs: Open index.html locally. If local script restrictions prevent loading, use the included Python server.

support.title: Display and sharing limits
paragraphs: 3D requires WebGL2 and sufficient memory. Check a saved presentation in the recipient’s supported PowerPoint client before presenting. This viewer is for demonstration, education and research, not diagnosis.

privacy.title: Local image processing
paragraphs: The browser importer reads selected files and converts pixels locally. The inspected import path does not upload pixel data to a codec service.

privacy.title: Presentation and browser storage
paragraphs: Converted studies are embedded in PowerPoint custom XML and cached in IndexedDB. Sharing or cloud-saving the presentation can therefore transmit the study through Microsoft or another storage service.

privacy.title: Network resources
paragraphs: The hosted add-in loads its web assets and Microsoft Office.js. A configured remote study loads data from its specified address. Optional setup and example-data import tools download dependencies or datasets.

privacy.title: Patient information
paragraphs: The browser package omits selected direct identifiers such as patient name and ID, but retains other descriptive and imaging information. It does not remove burned-in text or certify anonymization; inspect metadata and pixels before sharing.

privacy.title: Removal
paragraphs: Remove study clears the slide’s saved study reference and schedules package/cache cleanup. Original DICOM files, exported static packages and other presentation copies remain under your control.

privacy.title: Host boundaries
paragraphs: PowerPoint, browser and cloud-storage handling is separate from the viewer. No dedicated analytics or crash-report upload integration was identified in the inspected first-party viewer and importer paths.
